ITEM.PTXT: Various settings related to the ETC system can be made on the HDD navigation system display.

ENTRY.PTXT: Switches the interrupt display during ETC system use while the navigation mode screen is displayed between "On" and "Off".
Switches the voice guidance during ETC system use between "On" and "Off".
Switches the warning for a forgotten ETC card, etc. approximately 20 seconds after the power (ACC or IG) is turned ON between "On" and "Off".
Warning Voice Guidance at ACC ON
Switches the warning voice guidance for a forgotten ETC card, etc. approximately 20 seconds after the power (ACC or IG) is turned ON between "On" and "Off".
Switches the warning for a card left in the unit when the power (ACC or IG) is turned OFF between "On" and "Off".
